summary: chore(deps): drop stale dependabot ignores and unused jest-watch-typeahead
description:
Because:

- The jest-watch-typeahead ignore was waiting on a react-scripts
  update, but create-react-app was ejected in 2023 and nothing uses
  the plugin.
- The mailparser ignore pointed at FXA-5351, which is done; the test
  helper is on mailparser 3.x now.

This commit:

- Removes both dependency-name ignores from dependabot.yml.
- Removes jest-watch-typeahead from fxa-settings dependencies and
  devDependencies, and refreshes yarn.lock.

Closes FXA-9553
